criticism: The getExchangeRate function returns the exchange rate for an investor based on whether the investor is an initial investor or not. However, the function does not check whether the investor is an initial investor before setting the exchange rate. This can cause the contract to set the exchange rate for non-early investors, leading to a loss of tokens.

The ICOopen function checks whether the ICO is running based on whether the ICO is funding and the current time is before the start date. However, the function does not check whether the ICO is funding before checking the current time. This can cause the contract to return true even if the ICO is not funding, leading to a loss of tokens.

The addInitialInvestor function adds an investor to the list of initial investors. However, the function does not check whether the investor is already in the list of initial investors before adding them. This can cause the contract to add the same investor multiple times, leading to a loss of tokens.

The addToken function adds tokens to the total supply and the balance of an investor. However, the function does not check whether the investor is already in the list of initial investors before adding them. This can cause the contract to add the same investor multiple times, leading to a loss of tokens.

The setEarlyInvestorExchangeRate function sets the exchange rate for early investors. However, the function does not check whether the investor is an early investor before setting the exchange rate. This can cause the contract to set the exchange rate for non-early investors, leading to a loss of tokens.

The setStartDate function sets the start date of the ICO. However, the function does not check whether the start date is before the current time before setting it. This can cause the contract to set the start date to a time in the past, leading to a loss of tokens.

The setStartRefund function sets whether refunds are allowed. However, the function does not check whether refunds are allowed before setting the flag. This can cause the contract to allow refunds even if they are not allowed, leading to a loss of tokens.
